children: Planet Labs has shipped its Tanager-2 satellite to Vandenberg Space Force Base for an upcoming SpaceX rideshare mission, a move the company says will double its hyperspectral capacity and halve revisit times for detecting methane super-emitters as part of its partnership with Carbon Mapper. Carbon Mapper CEO Riley Duren says the organization's methane detection efforts have already enabled mitigation of large sources in diverse regions. Planet plans to deploy at least three additional Tanager satellites after Tanager-2.
